A first-generation college graduate and Howard University alumna, Kiki began college at just 16 years old and went on to build a nationally recognized career in entrepreneurship and communications. She is the founder of Ayers Publicity, where she has worked with renowned talent including Floyd Mayweather, Snoop Dogg, Randy Moss, Ari Lennox, and A Boogie Wit Da Hoodie, along with major brands and companies across entertainment, business, and technology.

Kiki is also the founder of My Best Kid Life, a nonprofit and media platform creating opportunities and resources for children and families. After overcoming his challenges and excelling at Cornell University, Gary became a sought-after speaker on the college circuit. His experiences led him to establish the NSLS in 2001 to empower students and foster leadership skills across the nation; to create a bridge for some of the brightest youth to become successful leaders who make the world a better place.

Since then, he's spoken to nearly one million people across the globe, trained teams at places like Coca-Cola, Apple, and Nike, won seven national speaking titles, and wrote two best-selling books on college success. He's given a TEDx talk at UCLA, appeared on a reality show on NBC, and has a YouTube video with 18 million views. network.stated_total_quote: Currently, there are over 2,000 colleges and universities that recognize ACE and NCCRS college credit recommendations. Credit recommendations can be transferred to an academic institution once (1) the member has submitted an official transcript from The NSLS to be sent to the receiving academic institution and (2) the receiving academic institution has received, evaluated, and agreed to accept the credit recommendations as transferable credit.
network.coverage_note: The NSLS is a leadership honor society that partners with over 800 colleges and universities, but it does not operate its own traditional campuses. No specific Erasmus+ mobility partners are listed in the evidence.
